data.name: Delara
data.gender_notes: Delara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'del' meaning 'noble', and 'ara' meaning 'light'. This name signifies a noble and enlightened individual in Islamic culture. The name Delara carries the meaning “Noble, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Delara usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Delara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Delara total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
